specialist: schema soundness + UNIQUE on idempotency_key + indexes + append-only enforcement
summary: Schema is correct (UNIQUE on idempotency_key, composite (branch_id, stockable_type, stockable_id), CHECK constraints non-negative + reserved<=on_hand). Hot indexes match service queries (branch+stockable lookup, threshold scan). Critical gap: stock_movements 'append-only' is enforced ONLY at the Eloquent model level (boot()->updating/deleting throws LogicException). Unlike audit_logs (2026_04_22_000002 L86-131) which installs BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers in MySQL + RAISE(ABORT) in SQLite, stock_movements has NO database-level trigger. Any DB::table('stock_movements')->delete() or raw SQL DELETE bypasses the model guard entirely. The CleanupTestFixturesCommand already uses DB::table('stock_movements') in production codebase (test cleanup), so the precedent is present.

findings.title: stock_movements has no DB-level BEFORE DELETE/UPDATE trigger (relies on Eloquent boot() only)
findings.primary_source: Migration 2026_04_27_143130 L11-29 contains zero DB::statement / CREATE TRIGGER statements. StockMovement.php L46-55 model booted() throws LogicException only when Eloquent saves/deletes. Any raw query (DB::table, DB::statement, MySQL CLI, phpMyAdmin) bypasses the model entirely. Compare audit_logs migration 2026_04_22_000002 L86-131 which installs MySQL BEFORE UPDATE+BEFORE DELETE triggers using SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' and SQLite RAISE(ABORT).
findings.impact: The 'stock_movements is append-only audit trail' claim in StockMovement.php L9-10 + the system-wide invariant in CLAUDE.md is not enforced at the storage layer. An operator with DB access, a misconfigured cleanup script (CleanupTestFixturesCommand L182/185/188 already opens this door), a future Outbox replay tool, or a DBA running mass deletes for 'cleanup' can erase decrement history with no log trail. NF525-comparable claim of integrity is therefore weaker for stock than for audit_logs/z_reports. Reconciliation of stock movements against orders (forensic audit) can be silently corrupted.
findings.user_friendly_question: Owner — la table stock_movements est documentée comme append-only mais la garde existe seulement au niveau Eloquent (model boot). Aucun trigger MySQL/SQLite. Un DELETE direct (`DB::table('stock_movements')->delete()`) bypasse silencieusement. Audit_logs/z_reports ont des triggers BEFORE DELETE qui SIGNAL '45000'. Veux-tu (1) ajouter les mêmes triggers via une migration nouvelle, (2) garder l'état actuel + simple GRANT-level mitigation documentée, ou (3) reporter en V1.0.2?
findings.remediation_proposal: New migration (NOT modifying applied migrations): mirror audit_logs trigger pattern. MySQL: `CREATE TRIGGER stock_movements_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON stock_movements FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'stock_movements is append-only.'` + same for DELETE. SQLite: `CREATE TRIGGER ... BEFORE DELETE ... BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'stock_movements is append-only.'); END;` Add a feature test running DB::table('stock_movements')->delete() and expecting QueryException.
findings.keep_current_working: Today the model boot() catches the vast majority of code paths (StockService, listeners, dashboard all use Eloquent). No regression risk if trigger added — model already throws before reaching DB; trigger becomes belt-and-suspenders.

findings.title: stock_movements_idempotency_unique is on a NULLABLE column
findings.primary_source: `$table->string('idempotency_key')->nullable()->unique('stock_movements_idempotency_unique');` — MySQL allows multiple NULL values in a UNIQUE index. SQLite allows none. Cross-engine inconsistency.
findings.impact: Today StockService always sets idempotency_key (sha1 composite). But the schema permits NULL inserts (manual_in / rupture_set reasons could write without a key, depending on backfill). MySQL silently allows duplicate NULLs; SQLite test environment would reject the second NULL. CI may pass on SQLite while prod has NULL-key rows that bypass dedup.
findings.user_friendly_question: Owner — la colonne idempotency_key est nullable + UNIQUE. MySQL accepte plusieurs NULL, SQLite n'en accepte qu'un. Tous les writes prod passent par StockService (toujours non-null), donc pas de bug actif. Veux-tu (1) rendre la colonne NOT NULL via migration future (1 ligne + backfill), ou (2) garder en l'état avec assertion runtime (StockMovement::saving guard)?
findings.remediation_proposal: Migration future: backfill NULL keys with deterministic sha1 from (reference_type, reference_id, stockable_id, delta, reason, created_at) → then ALTER COLUMN idempotency_key VARCHAR NOT NULL. Defer if no current prod NULL.
findings.keep_current_working: No bug today; preventive heal only.

findings.title: Hot read path index check: branch_id+stockable_type+stockable_id is UNIQUE (covers SELECT). No separate covering index on (branch_id, on_hand) for low-stock dashboard.
findings.primary_source: Dashboard lowAlerts query: `whereIn('branch_id', $branchIds)->whereNotNull('threshold_low')->whereColumn('on_hand', '<=', 'threshold_low')->orderBy('branch_id')->orderBy('on_hand')->limit(200)`. UNIQUE covers branch_id lookup but whereColumn comparison requires full row scan within branch.
findings.impact: At small dataset (1 branch, < 1k SKU) — negligible. At multi-branch (100 branches × 500 SKU = 50k rows) the lowAlerts endpoint scans all rows of each branch per request. Dashboard polls — could become a hot N×M scan. F-016a-BIS migration added stock_levels_manual_reason_idx but no compound index for the dashboard hot path.
findings.user_friendly_question: Owner — le dashboard lowAlerts scanne (branch_id, on_hand, threshold_low) sans index dédié. Aujourd'hui 1 branche / Le Cayenne = négligeable. Si tu prévois SaaS multi-tenant > 50k SKU dans 12 mois, on peut ajouter un index composite préventif. Veux-tu (1) ajouter dès V1.0.1 (1 migration), (2) reporter en V1.0.2 quand le SaaS démarre, ou (3) laisser tel quel?
findings.remediation_proposal: Future migration: `CREATE INDEX stock_levels_low_alerts_idx ON stock_levels (branch_id, threshold_low, on_hand)`. Verify EXPLAIN plan switches to index range scan.
findings.keep_current_working: Le Cayenne single-resto fits in memory regardless. Preventive only.

findings.title: CHECK constraints applied only on non-sqlite — sqlite tests rely on model::saving() guard
findings.primary_source: Migration L26: `if (DB::getDriverName() !== 'sqlite')` skips CHECK constraints on test runner. StockLevel model::booted() L64-75 throws InvalidArgumentException on negative on_hand/reserved + reserved>on_hand.
findings.impact: Test environment (sqlite) catches violations at model level, prod (MySQL) catches at DB level. Dual defense. Acceptable. Just worth noting that raw DB::table writes in prod would still hit the CHECK; raw writes in tests would silently succeed.
findings.user_friendly_question: Pas d'action requise. Juste pour info.
